Name: Bollinger Band StdDev
Description: StdDev multiplier for BB width (Max capped at 3.0 to prevent overfitting)

Name: Long Entry on Wick Touch
Description: Enter if low touches lower band (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Long Entry on Body in Zone
Description: Enter if close ≤ lower band (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Long Trigger (% From Lower Band)
Description: % below lower band to trigger (min 0.5% to avoid band extremes)

Name: Short Entry on Wick Touch
Description: Enter if high touches upper band (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Short Entry on Body in Zone
Description: Enter if close ≥ upper band (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Short Trigger (% From Upper Band)
Description: % above upper band to trigger (min 0.5% to avoid band extremes)

Name: ATR Length for Filter
Description: ATR period for entry filter (separate from trailing stop ATR)

Name: Max ATR Filter (Points)
Description: Maximum ATR value to allow entries for mean reversion (ATR <= max). Low ATR = exhausted move ready to reverse (good). High ATR = strong momentum (bad for mean reversion). Range 1.0-6.0 points

Name: Min ATR Filter (Points)
Description: Minimum ATR floor (optional) to ensure stops aren't too tight. Default 0.5 points. ATR must be >= this AND <= Max ATR Filter

Name: Enable Trend Filter
Description: Trade with trend only (Long > EMA, Short < EMA) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Enable ADX Filter
Description: Trade only when ADX < Threshold (Ranging Markets) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Max ADX Threshold
Description: Maximum ADX allowed for entry. Lower = Only extremely choppy. Higher = Allow some trend.

Name: Enable RTH Filter
Description: Restrict entries to RTH only (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: RTH Exit Buffer (minutes)
Description: Minutes before RTH end to start closing positions (0 = no auto-close)

Name: Daily Maintenance Start (HH:MM)
Description: Daily maintenance period start in Eastern Time (ES: 4:00 PM CT = 5:00 PM ET)

Name: Daily Maintenance End (HH:MM)
Description: Daily maintenance period end in Eastern Time (ES: 4:30 PM CT = 5:30 PM ET)

Name: Weekend Maintenance Start Day
Description: Weekend maintenance start day (0=Monday, 1=Tuesday, 2=Wednesday, 3=Thursday, 4=Friday, 5=Saturday, 6=Sunday). For ES futures: 4 (Friday)

Name: Weekend Maintenance Start Time (HH:MM)
Description: Weekend maintenance start time in Eastern Time (ES: Fri 4:00 PM CT = 5:00 PM ET)

Name: Weekend Maintenance End Day
Description: Weekend maintenance end day (0=Monday, 1=Tuesday, 2=Wednesday, 3=Thursday, 4=Friday, 5=Saturday, 6=Sunday). For ES futures: 6 (Sunday)

Name: Weekend Maintenance End Time (HH:MM)
Description: Weekend maintenance end time in Eastern Time (ES: Sun 5:00 PM CT = 6:00 PM ET)

Name: Maintenance Buffer Minutes
Description: Minutes before/after maintenance to exit/block trading

Name: Volume MA Length
Description: Rolling window for average volume calculation (used by volume filter)

Name: Max Volume Multiplier
Description: Volume filter for mean reversion - MAX volume allowed (volume <= avg * multiplier). Low volume = exhausted move ready to reverse. High volume = strong momentum (bad for mean reversion). Range 0.5-3.0 (1.0 = no filter, lower = more restrictive)

Name: Transaction Cost (Per Trade)
Description: Estimated friction per trade (Slippage + Commissions) to realistic PnL. E.g. $4 comm + $12.50 slip = 16.5

Name: TP Method
Description: Take profit method (0=Fixed BB at Entry, 1=Fixed ATR, 2=Opposite BB) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: Opposite Bollinger Band TP
Description: FIXED: Controlled by TP Method (do not optimize directly)

Name: Fixed ATR TP
Description: FIXED: Controlled by TP Method (do not optimize directly)

Name: Fixed BB at Entry TP
Description: FIXED: Controlled by TP Method (do not optimize directly)

Name: ATR Multiplier for TP
Description: Fixed TP ATR multiplier - reduced max to prevent overfitting

Name: Initial Stop Loss (%)
Description: Fixed stop loss % - min 1.0% to avoid tight stops that cause quick losses

Name: ATR Multiplier for Trailing Stop
Description: Trailing stop ATR multiplier - reduced max to prevent overfitting

Name: Trailing Delay (bars)
Description: Bars before trailing stop begins tightening (0 = immediate, max 7 to avoid delayed trailing)

Name: POP_SIZE
Description: Population size - reduced to prevent overfitting

Name: NUM_GEN
Description: Number of generations - reduced to prevent overfitting

Name: MUT_PB
Description: Mutation probability (increased from 0.35 for more exploration)

Name: TARGET_TRADES_DAY
Description: Ideal trades/day - reduced to be more realistic for combined filters

Name: TRADES_PENALTY_WEIGHT
Description: Penalty for excess trades - reduced to be less restrictive

Name: DD_WEIGHT
Description: Drawdown penalty weight - increased to prioritize risk management

Name: DATA_SPLITS
Description: In-sample fraction per period - 60-70% for better generalization (30-40% OOS)

Name: RSI Overbought
Description: Threshold for Overbought (Short Entry Blocked if < this)

Name: RSI Oversold
Description: Threshold for Oversold (Long Entry Blocked if > this)

Name: USE_INTERLEAVED_SPLIT
Description: Use interleaved IS/OOS periods instead of single split

Name: NUM_SPLIT_PERIODS
Description: Number of alternating periods (IS-OOS-IS-OOS-IS) - odd number recommended

Name: MIN_TRADES_DAY
Description: MUST have at least 0.1 trades/day (approx 1 per 2 weeks) - relaxed for combined logic

Name: MIN_TRADES_PEN_WEIGHT
Description: Scalar penalty — zero trades = -50 (Less harsh death penalty)

Name: NORM_SORTINO_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Sortino Ratio (used in fitness calculation)

Name: NORM_DD_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Max Drawdown in dollars (used in fitness calculation)

Name: NORM_PF_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Profit Factor (used in fitness calculation)

Name: NORM_TRADES_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Avg Trades/Day (used in fitness calculation) - reduced to 3.0 for realistic expectations

Name: NORM_PNL_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Total Profit in dollars (used in fitness calculation) - increased to prevent maxing out

Name: NORM_PROFIT_TRADE_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Avg Profit Per Trade (used in fitness calculation)

Name: MIN_WIN_RATE
Description: Minimum win rate threshold (hard constraint - strategies below this are eliminated)

Name: SORTINO_CAP
Description: Maximum Sortino value before capping (prevents unrealistic values)

Name: MIN_TRADE_DURATION
Description: Hard Limit: Min avg minutes per trade

Name: MAX_WIN_RATE_CAP
Description: Hard Limit: Max win rate before penalty

Name: LIMIT_MAX_LOSS
Description: Hard Limit: Severe loss penalty threshold

Name: LIMIT_MIN_SORTINO
Description: Hard Limit: Severe Sortino penalty threshold
